name: Rank related Instagram hashtags from recent posts with RecentReborn and n8n Form

parameters.content:
## Rank related Instagram hashtags from recent posts with RecentReborn and n8n Form

### How it works

This workflow collects an Instagram hashtag and sample size from an n8n form, or uses defaults during a manual test run. It validates the request, searches recent Instagram posts through RecentReborn with retry/backoff handling, then counts and ranks hashtags co-used with the requested hashtag. When opened from the form, it renders the ranked hashtag table as a completion page.

### Setup steps

- Configure the RecentReborn node with the required API credentials or account connection.
- Review the Config node values for defaultHashtag, defaultSampleSize, maxSampleSize, and maxRetries.
- Publish or enable the n8n form trigger so users can submit hashtag analysis requests.
- Run the Manual test run trigger once to confirm defaults, validation, retries, and the results page work as expected.

### Customization

Adjust the Config limits and defaults, change the validation logic for accepted hashtag formats or sample sizes, and edit the ranking/results page code to change how related hashtags are scored or displayed.

## Start and defaults

Provides the two entry points: a user-facing hashtag analysis form and a manual test trigger, then applies default configuration values used by the rest of the workflow.

## Validate submitted request

Reads form answers or manual-run defaults, checks whether the hashtag and requested sample size are acceptable, and shows an input problem page when validation fails.

## Run Instagram search

Prepares each search attempt, calls RecentReborn to retrieve recent Instagram hashtag posts, and normalizes the search result into either usable post data or a retry/failure state.

## Handle search retries

Decides whether a failed or incomplete search should be retried and, when needed, waits before looping back to prepare another search attempt.

## Rank related hashtags

Counts hashtags that appear alongside the searched hashtag in the retrieved posts and prepares the ranked co-usage data for presentation.

## Build and display results

Builds the form completion results page, checks whether the workflow was opened from the form, and displays the final related hashtag table to the user.

parameters.formDescription:
Find the hashtags that recent Instagram posts use together with yours. Results appear on the next page.

Sample size: the larger the sample, the more search credits are used (about one credit per 25 posts) and the longer it takes for the results to come back.
